assertions: Preview is zero-write and returns a deterministic fingerprint.
Apply re-reads the current revision and rejects a stale or mismatched fingerprint.
Durable step receipts prevent recreation of acknowledged assets after retry.
Published state is retained when cleanup records an operational anomaly.

required: same key and fingerprint returns the same receipt
lost acknowledgement resumes from the last durable step
cleanup failure creates bounded anomaly evidence

forbidden_observations: cleanup failure treated as publication failure
